cover.coreProposition: Reusable runtimes should snapshot request-mutable option containers per invocation while intentionally preserving live clients by reference; this copy-on-mutation boundary avoids demonstrated aliasing and cloning failures without pretending to provide deep isolation.
cover.visualMetaphor: A stable central conduit feeds several fresh translucent option sleeves
cover.semanticObject: One durable transport core paired with distinct per-call configuration layers
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a strong shared core, separated lightweight layers and clear visual hierarchy
